equations: n=P*V/(R*T); finite equilibrated headspace supplied explicitly, not inferred from food matrix
Aspirated amount = remaining vial gas * injection_volume/headspace_volume; vial -> syringe -> column/exhaust; cancellation preserves each compartment
N2 required = (carrier_reference_volume+drift_reference_volume)*P_reference/(R*T_reference); gas exhaustion truncates time
Source carrier program 2mL/min first120s, linear to100mL/min at1200s, then100mL/min; integral defines synthetic retention-volume coordinate
Eluted analyte amount = injected amount * positive-truncated Gaussian CDF(carrier_volume); signal=sum(gain*dn/dt * IMS-bin Gaussian probability)
IMS axis is measured t_d/t_RIP dimensionless; widths/gain/method transfer assumed; source QH1 monomer/dimer relative volumes used only as explicit matrix-dependent assumed channel weights
ROI area from observed signal windows; external standards area=slope*concentration+intercept; no hidden composition read by analyzer

limitations: 旧FlavourSpec实验文献的60C GC/45C IMS和9.8cm/500Vcm漂移管不是25型号硬件规格；只作源数据条件，25型号100C/200C上限依厂家2411页2。
源文称80VOCs，表80峰中3个CAS重复；按77个独立CAS计数，不将单体/二聚体各算一种物质。
文中方法描述漂移时间为毫秒，但Table1列名和谱图定义明确为Dt[RIPrel]；库保持无量纲比值，绝对漂移时间null。
气体mL/min源未给参考温压，数值过程显式采用宿主参考温压，不声称标准流量计标定。
主机、PAL3、60个10/20mL瓶位按厂家第一页图片分件；外廓和25kg是整套，不冒充主机或单部件质量。
局部尺寸、内部GC盘管/IMS管、铰链、气接头与运动轴行程为照片/工程代理，部件质量惯量摩擦未知。
机身服务盖可开和PAL3三个平移轴采用过程唯一权威，动作轨迹非原厂运动控制或机器人接触验证。
触屏/手持控制器只显示简化工程遥测，不实现VOCal/原厂PAL菜单和数据通讯。
库提供真实实验峰位置与信号体积；二维峰宽、气体物种迁移/离子产额、基线及标线为显式假设，未知样品浓度不从私有账本直接回传。
前左维护盖绕+X工程关节；厂家未给门铰链结构，不声称OEM功能。
仅整机25kg为厂家值；各部件惯量按包围盒+0.1kg数值代理，真实部件质量/惯量未知。
前部局部配色/控制器/PAL形态参照厂家照片，全部局部尺寸工程近似；针尖目标与60瓶盘位置按运行轴精确绑定。
运行层孵育为已平衡顶空瓶的单节点温度准备；未实现瓶子移入独立孵育仓的夹持操作。
10mL与20mL运行输入均支持；当前60瓶视觉采用20mL外形代理，不自动缩放10mL瓶。
吸样/注射的物质转移在各行程完成时离散发生；未验证连续活塞流量或针筒压力动力学。
刚体原生转换用包络近似猜轴时混淆0.800m深与0.790m高；本资产转换包装器依manifest强制Z向上，无共享转换器修改。
77 distinct CAS with80 empirical peaks from one food-matrix study on earlier FlavourSpec; no raw electronic 2D response arrays.
GC/IMS max100C and syringe max200C from FlavourSpec25; incubator bound and travel/thermal parameters are engineering assumptions.
Host supplies an already-equilibrated finite headspace; no matrix partition kinetics, pressure regulation or actual vial opening.
Source drift coordinates are dimensionless RIP ratios; absolute drift seconds, mobility and reduced mobility are unknown.
Signal widths/gain, source monomer/dimer weights and method transfer are explicit synthetic assumptions; no ion reaction chemistry/noise/saturation model.
Concentrations require caller-supplied calibration; source food peak volumes are not pure standards.
Mass and geometry motions verified only within the implemented surrogate; robot manipulation/hardware not_run.
Trusted-host Session filtering is not filesystem or process isolation.
